slots.rationale: 5 incidents in the same lunch hour, Monday to Thursday, in 4 weeks. One person at the level 1 landing covers both flights.
slots.tip: Stand on the level 1 landing. You can see both flights of stairs from there.

assumption: 60% of hotspot incidents are avoided when a person is present. Stated, not measured. Avoided = incidents in 4 weeks × 0.6.
